description: This Java class 'Listener' handles web application startup and shutdown procedures for the OpenMRS platform. It manages initialization tasks such as loading properties, setting up security filters, module loading, context configuration, and clean shutdown activities.

classes.name: Listener
classes.description: Handles web application startup and shutdown for OpenMRS, including context initialization, module loading, security setup, and cleanup activities.

methods.name: sessionCreated
methods.description: Passes HttpSession creation event to all registered HttpSessionListener beans.

methods.name: sessionDestroyed
methods.description: Passes HttpSession destruction event to all registered HttpSessionListener beans.

methods.name: getHttpSessionListeners
methods.description: Retrieves all configured HttpSessionListener beans from the Spring context.

methods.name: contextInitialized
methods.description: Main entry point when the web app starts; performs environment validation, loads properties, setups filters, starts modules, and initializes the application context.

methods.name: loadCsrfGuardProperties
methods.description: Loads CSRF protection configuration, either from a file in the application data directory or from the default resource, and initializes CsrfGuard.

methods.name: setupNeeded
methods.description: Determines if the startup setup or database migration steps need to be performed, based on properties and database state.

methods.name: startOpenmrs
methods.description: Performs the initialization of OpenMRS including module startup, scheduling, and context configuration.

methods.name: loadConstants
methods.description: Loads application startup constants from the servlet context parameters.

methods.name: setApplicationDataDirectory
methods.description: Configures the application data directory used by OpenMRS based on context parameters.

methods.name: getContextPath
methods.description: Returns the web application's context path without a leading slash.

methods.name: clearDWRFile
methods.description: Resets or clears the DWR module configuration XML file to prevent load errors.

methods.name: copyCustomizationIntoWebapp
methods.description: Copies customized static files into the web application directory based on runtime properties.

methods.name: copyFile
methods.description: Copies a file from a source path to a destination path, returning success status.

methods.name: loadBundledModules
methods.description: Loads modules bundled within the web application from WEB-INF/bundledModules.

methods.name: contextDestroyed
methods.description: Executes cleanup activities including shutdown of modules, database drivers, and memory leak prevention, when the web app is shutting down.

methods.name: getActualRootCause
methods.description: Recursively finds and returns the root cause of a Throwable.
